tests: Add Other File on Packages, and Paste on Packages, each say they cannot create files inside the root resources folder
steps:
1. In Project Explorer, right-click Packages > Add > Add Other File, and press Enter on the name MyFile: the notification cannot create files inside the root resources folder.
2. Copy Resources/CUSTOM/notes.txt, click Packages and press Ctrl+V: the same notification. Nothing is added to Packages.
Control: Add > Add Other File on a folder of Resources creates the file there.
